name: Wer gewinnt?
overview: Brian brings new contestants into the game – and the challenges become even tougher, more absurd, and more unpredictable. Who will go the distance? Who will lose all inhibitions? In every episode, big personalities, wild strategies, and sheer madness collide – and the tasks might take the contestants all across Germany or even beyond. Anything can happen! Whether it’s strategy, luck, or pure determination – in the end, only one question matters: Who wins?
